# corresponding target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:correspondingTarget`](gmeow-correspondingTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/correspondingTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The target-domain element of a [`gmeow:Correspondence`](../classes/gmeow-Correspondence.md) — the other half of a mapped pair. Functional: exactly one target element per correspondence.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Correspondence`](../classes/gmeow-Correspondence.md) -> `?`; functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:correspondingTarget`](gmeow-correspondingTarget.md) from [`gmeow:Correspondence`](../classes/gmeow-Correspondence.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
